job.title: Management Accountant (two days per week remote working)
job.description:
About the Company
A well-established business in Cayman is looking for an ambitious Management Accountant to join its finance team. This is a hands-on role working closely with Senior Management and teams across the business, with responsibility for the day-to-day management accounting and financial reporting activities of the company.

 

About the Opportunity
This is an excellent opportunity for an accounting professional looking to build their career within a commercial, internal finance environment and gain exposure to the operations of a busy and growing business.

 

Day-to-day responsibilities will include preparing journal entries, accruals and balance sheet reconciliations; supporting month-end, quarter-end and year-end close; preparing and analyzing financial and management reports; and investigating variances, trends and potential financial risks.

 

This is a varied position offering the opportunity to take real ownership of key accounting activities while developing a strong understanding of the commercial operations behind the numbers.

 

About You
You’ll be an ambitious and commercially minded accounting professional with at least 4 years of progressive accounting or financial reporting experience and strong experience with month-end close, reconciliations and financial reporting. A full professional accounting qualification such as CPA, ACCA, ACA, CA is required.

 

Only Caymanian or Status Holder candidates are encouraged to apply.

job.title: Cybersecurity Operations Lead
job.description:
We are recruiting on behalf of a respected organisation for an experienced Cybersecurity Operations Lead - Risk Management professional. This is a key leadership role focused on strengthening cybersecurity operations, managing information security risks, and enhancing the organisation’s overall security posture. You will play a vital role in safeguarding critical systems, leading security initiatives, and ensuring effective threat detection, incident response, and vulnerability management across the business.

Company Information

This opportunity is with a well-established organisation operating within a highly regulated environment. The business is committed to maintaining the highest standards of security, governance, and operational excellence while fostering a collaborative and forward-thinking workplace culture.

You will join a skilled and professional team that works closely with technology, risk, compliance, and business stakeholders to protect the organisation's systems and information assets. The environment encourages continuous learning, innovation, and the adoption of cybersecurity best practices.

Responsibilities and Duties

As the Cybersecurity Operations Lead, you will:

  • Manage the relationship with the outsourced Security Operations Centre (SOC) and act as the primary point of contact for security operations services.
  • Lead cybersecurity incident response activities, including investigation, containment, remediation, and post-incident reviews.
  • Oversee vulnerability management processes, ensuring timely identification and remediation of security weaknesses.
  • Conduct third-party security assessments and support vendor risk management initiatives.
  • Monitor emerging cyber threats and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
  • Collaborate with IT, Risk, Compliance, Audit, and business teams to strengthen information security controls.
  • Manage cybersecurity vendors, service providers, and related contractual obligations.
  • Drive continuous improvement across security operations, monitoring capabilities, and operational resilience programmes.

Qualifications and Skills

To succeed in this role, you should have:

  • A Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC, or other relevant cybersecurity qualifications.
  • A minimum of five years' experience in cybersecurity, information security, or IT infrastructure environments.
  • Proven experience in security operations, incident response, threat management, or vulnerability management.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks, standards, and risk management principles.
  • Experience managing third-party suppliers, security vendors, or outsourced security services.
  • Knowledge of security monitoring tools, threat detection technologies, and security operations processes.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively across all levels of an organisation.

Benefits and Perks

In return, you can expect:

  • The opportunity to lead and influence critical cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Exposure to a broad range of security technologies, projects, and business functions.
  • A collaborative and supportive working environment.
  • Opportunities for professional development and ongoing training.
  • A highly visible role with regular interaction with senior leadership.
  • The chance to make a significant impact on the organisation's security strategy and resilience.
  • A stable and professional environment within a respected organisation.
  • Career growth opportunities within a developing cybersecurity function.

job.title: Assistant Technology Manager

Join a globally recognised professional services and consulting organisation that partners with businesses across a wide range of industries to solve complex business and technology challenges. The company is known for its collaborative culture, commitment to innovation, and investment in learning and professional development.

You will be part of a high-performing Technology & Transformation team that helps organisations enhance security, improve operational efficiency, manage risk, and maximise the value of their technology investments. Working alongside experienced consultants and industry specialists, you will contribute to impactful projects that drive lasting business results.

Responsibilities and Duties

As an Assistant Manager within Technology & Transformation, you will:

  • Lead the day-to-day delivery of client engagements and maintain strong client relationships.
  • Provide expert advice on Microsoft Azure architecture, cloud security, and operational controls.
  • Support clients across Azure, Microsoft 365, and hybrid cloud environments.
  • Conduct cloud security and risk assessments to identify vulnerabilities and improvement opportunities.
  • Design and implement practical solutions to optimise clients' technology environments.
  • Advise on cloud governance, risk mitigation, automation, and operational best practices.
  • Diagnose complex cloud-related issues and develop effective, business-focused solutions.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and stakeholders to deliver high-quality consulting services.

Qualifications and Skills

To be successful in this role, you should have:

  • A Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

Benefits and Perks

In return for your expertise, you can expect:

  • Opportunities to work with leading cloud technologies and transformation programmes.
  • Competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package.
  • Access to global resources, expertise, and career development opportunities.

job.title: Systems Analyst

job.title: Junior IT Officer
job.description:

  • Contribute to IT projects, digital transformation initiatives, and process improvement activities.
  • Liaise with external vendors and support cybersecurity, compliance, business continuity, and onboarding activities.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Experience supporting Microsoft 365 applications and business systems would be advantageous.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

  • Excellent communication and customer service skills.

In return, you will have the opportunity to:

job.title: Junior Support Technician

  • Ongoing training and development opportunities.
  • Exposure to enterprise systems, ERP support and business technology projects.

job.title: Cloud Developer
job.description:
We are recruiting on behalf of a well-established organisation seeking a talented Cloud Microservices Developer to join its growing technology team. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced software developer who is passionate about cloud computing, microservices architecture, API development, and scalable application design. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining modern cloud-native solutions that support critical business operations and digital innovation.

Company Information

Join a forward-thinking organisation operating within a technology-driven environment that places a strong emphasis on innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. The company is investing heavily in modern cloud technologies and digital transformation initiatives, creating an exciting landscape for skilled software professionals.

You will become part of a highly collaborative team of developers, engineers, and technical specialists who are committed to delivering secure, scalable, and high-performing cloud solutions. The culture encourages knowledge sharing, professional development, and the adoption of industry best practices.

Responsibilities and Duties

As a Cloud Microservices Developer, you will:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable microservices using modern development frameworks and best practices.
  • Build and integrate RESTful APIs, with exposure to GraphQL or gRPC where required.
  • Develop and deploy cloud-native applications across AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform environments.
  • Create and manage containerised applications using Docker and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes or managed cloud services.
  • Implement event-driven architectures and integrate systems using messaging and streaming technologies including Kafka, RabbitMQ, Amazon SQS/SNS, or EventBridge.
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to implement and enhance CI/CD pipelines, improving deployment efficiency and reliability.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimise application performance, scalability, availability, and resource utilisation.
  • Produce technical documentation, participate in code reviews, and support ongoing platform enhancement and incident resolution.

Qualifications and Skills

To be successful in this role, you should have:

  • A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Computer Systems, or a related discipline.
  • 2 to 5 years of experience developing enterprise-level software applications.
  • At least 2 years of hands-on experience building and implementing microservices-based solutions.
  • Strong experience with Java (Spring Boot), .NET, Node.js, Go, Python, or similar modern programming languages.
  • Practical knowledge of cloud platforms, particularly AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Git, CI/CD tools, and automated testing methodologies.
  • Strong understanding of API security standards including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and JWT authentication.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, teamwork, and analytical skills, with experience working in Agile environments such as Scrum or Kanban.

Desirable Skills

The following would be advantageous:

  • Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Hexagonal Architecture, or Clean Architecture.
  • Apache Kafka and event-driven architecture experience.
  • Service Mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd.
  • Observability and monitoring tools including Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or OpenTelemetry.
  • Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.
  • AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or Kubernetes certifications.

Benefits and Perks

In return for your expertise, you can expect:

  • Competitive salary package.
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge cloud and microservices technologies.
  • Exposure to large-scale, business-critical cloud platforms and distributed systems.
  • Collaborative and supportive team environment.
  • Ongoing professional development and training opportunities.
  • Career progression within a growing technology function.
  • Participation in innovative projects that drive digital transformation.
  • A culture that values continuous learning, technical excellence, and employee growth.

job.description:
About the Company: 
A Big 4 Consulting firm on island in Cayman are looking for a US Tax Senior with client facing experience to join their team.


About the Opportunity: 
An exciting opportunity for a US Tax professional to join a Big 4 Consulting firm in the Cayman Islands. You will work on a range of US tax compliance and advisory engagements for corporate clients, gain valuable experience and have the opportunity to progress your career in the Cayman Islands


About You:
You will be CPA qualified with a minimum of 2 years client facing corporate US tax experience at a public accounting or advisory firm. Experience with hedge funds or corporate insurance clients is preferable.

job.title: Account Manager
job.description:
About the Opportunity

In this role based in the Cayman Islands, you will manage a portfolio of insurance clients and support all aspects of financial reporting, regulatory compliance, and day-to-day account oversight. This opportunity offers exposure to a fast-paced environment within the captive insurance sector and the chance to develop deep industry expertise while working closely with a collaborative team.

About You

You’ll likely be an Audit Senior with at least 2 years' experience auditing insurance, captive managers, or reinsurance portfolios, now looking to transition into a client-facing industry role. You hold an internationally recognised professional accounting designation (CPA, ACA, ACCA, CA, etc.).

job.title: Industry Accountant
job.description:
About the company:
A well known company on-island is looking for an Accountant to join their team.

About the opportunity:
This role is a stand out opportunity for a qualified accountant and will include the autonomous management of the accounts department, ensuring reporting deadlines are met and reporting to a Financial Controller.  

About you:
This role is ideal for a fully qualified accountant (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.) with previous experience managing a small team. Experience in stock and inventory is an advantage but not essential. A strong leader who is 'hands on' with experience in leading all levels of accounting staff.

job.title: Fund Accountant
job.description:
About the company:
A large international fund administrator is looking for a Fund Accountant to join their growing team. 

About the opportunity:
You will be responsible for the fund administration of a group of complex alternative investment funds including private equity, private debt and hedge funds. This company is one of the best places on-island to work with strong opportunities for progression, competitive salaries and benefits and great work life balance.

About you:
You will be a fully qualified accountant with strong technical knowledge of alternative investments. Whilst funds audit experience is preferred, general industry audit experience may also be considered.

job.title: Tax Senior
job.description: This is an extremely unique opportunity to practice US taxation in the Cayman Islands.  You’ll get the opportunity to work on some of the most interesting partnerships, individual and corporate structures imaginable and gain invaluable experience. Whilst working at a global, market leading firm, you’ll get the benefits this affords, and enjoy a beach lifestyle, tax-free salary and no commute in the beautiful Cayman Islands.

job.title: Associate - Corporate
job.description:
About the Company:
Join a premier global offshore law firm in the vibrant Cayman Islands, known for excellence in advising blue-chip corporate clients from all over the world. From M&A, joint ventures, and VC to crypto and fintech regulatory, this law firm really handles everything you can imagine in the corporate space.

About the Position:
Our client is seeking a high-calibre Corporate Associate to join their dynamic Cayman Islands team. Your role will involve supporting corporate clients in transactions across key jurisdictions and complex deals within tight deadlines.

About the Candidate:
We're seeking an experienced Corporate Associate with expertise in cross-border transactions from a recognised onshore or offshore firm. Join our client’s global firm in the Cayman Islands for a challenging yet balanced professional environment, and enjoy the unique lifestyle this desirable location offers.

job.title: Associate - Trust & Private Wealth
job.description:
About our client:
Our client is a leading, independent provider of specialised corporate, trust and fiduciary services with a wide network that allows them to provide reliable service. Their international client base includes some of the world’s top law firms, investment funds, financial institutions and high-net-worth individuals.

About the position: 
As an Associate, you will be working as a part of a dynamic team, acting as a point of contact in both contentious and non-contentious private client work, including trust and supplemental deed drafting, advisory work, will drafting, family office planning, wealth structuring, probate applications, trust applications and trust related disputes. 

About you: 

You must be a qualified associate within a relevant jurisdiction* with a minimum of 5 years post-qualification experience in all aspects of private client work. Desired skills include an ability to provide accurate, focused advice to clients and a proven ability to work both autonomously and as a part of a team.

* Cayman Islands, UK, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand and Canada

For more information or to apply, contact graham.blyth@cml.ky for a confidential conversation.

job.title: Crypto Accountant
job.description:
About the company:
Join the digital revolution! A crypto company on island is looking for a fully qualified accountant with a keen interest in cryptocurrencies to join their team.

About the opportunity:
You will be responsible for internal finance and helping interpret and set out the processes and audit procedures for the company. You will be working right at the leading edge of digital asset technology with close interaction with monitoring the markets, the mining facilities and new applications being built on the blockchain.

About you:
You must be a fully qualified accountant (CPA, CA, ACA, ACCA) with a Big4 / Top10 audit experience. You must have an agile mind and be able to work in a fast-paced environment where processes and procedures need to be established. They are rapidly expanding and so there is scope to get more involved with the technology, the operations and the overseas offices. This role is open to Caymanians, status holders and expats.
